nom: The Ordinary Azelaic Acid Suspension 10% Cream for Redness and Blemish-Prone Skin

avis.titre: Suffering with redness and uneven skin tone
avis.texte: I used this once within minutes my redness decreased 10 fold. Just bought this bottle and will be going back tomorrow to buy another. This will be a must in my routine forever. I have dry and sensitive skin

So i saw mixed reviews and decided to try it. After reading up i found it I needed a barrier before applying (what does that mean?). I use a moisturizer then wait for it to dry the apply a small amount then after it is dried apply the other moisturizer I have. I don't use it everyday ( your not suppose to) but I use it when my skin is irritated or I see any acne about to form and let me tell you it works WONDERS

avis.titre: Good for trying out Azelaic Aid
avis.texte: The Ordinary's azelaic acid (AA) is great if u want to try AA and see if it works for ur skin issues (acne, hyperpigmentation, rosacea, etc.) w/o spending much at first. The texture isn't my fav, but I found I could make the silicone-y, powdery feel disappear if I applied it after using my Colourpop vitamin C face oil serum. I doubted whether the texture would work w my foundations (CG Simply Ageless skin tint and Bare Minerals Original powder). I wasn't comfortable w/o my face oil under the AA, but my foundations were fine when I used face oil. The Ordinary's AA really helped prevent pimples forming around my mouth, which causes hyperpigmentation. Really great results. However, when I finished my Ordinary AA, I was ready to try the Anua one bc I don't like the slight, chemically burning smell (not actually burning, just the smell). The texture change was also a big bonus. The Anua one doesn't have the smell and absorbs easily. It is 2x the price, but from my use so far, I think it will last 2-3 longer than the Ordinary's bc u need to use a lot less of a serum in volume compared to a paste. So cost per use is about the same or better w the Anua.

avis.titre: be careful it does stinky and burns and removes slowly
avis.texte: I had stop using it but I'm trying to use something for my dark spots and refix my skin in my face and I'm sensitive and I'm just trying to get my skin back and just be careful by using this product but also trying to make my face brighter and no dark spots at all

I've not tried any prescriptions for my rosacea and I've never met anyone with worse than mine. I figured I'd live with it and cover it. Started perimenopause and it was like rosacea didn't take a holiday. Everything I've tried with The Ordinary (five products so far) has worked. It's taken a long time for a company to get it right in both potency and price. This cream is the only product in my 27 years with rosacea that has worked. It stops it by 85% (from my very first use) and reduces the redness from my hot flashes by more than half. If applied first, there can be a pilling issue with other products. All I do is let it dry for at least three minutes and there's no pilling. I'd use a lot of exclamation marks, but I want you to really hear me... It has changed my life.
I have been using it for about three weeks, but have not seen any results yet.

avis.titre: Very little product in the tube
avis.texte: I purchased this on July 20th, and here we are a week later and I am squeezing the last of it out of the tube, which felt pretty empty to begin with when I first got it. I use my products sparingly, and this shouldn't have run out in one week. I doesn't seem as though there was an ounce of product in the tube. There's not enough to use to say whether this product makes a difference or not.

avis.titre: Loved this product but my bottle was mostly air
avis.texte: I have been used this product for a little less than a week and it's been awesome. The catch - I was using it last night and a BIG air bubble came out and it's almost empty. I have used a pea sized amount twice a day for less than a week.

avis.titre: Cleared up Redness, irritation,  and texture
avis.texte: I have had some redness and texture on my cheek that nothing was helping. After a bit of research, I decided to give this a try. less than a week the texture has evened out, my skin doesn't feel angry, and the redness has gone down. I am very pleased with this purchase and will keep it in my rotation.

I love most The Ordinary products but this one did not hit the spot, primarily because there is hardly anything in the tube. It also can only be put over a moisturizer, and cannot be used as a base whatsoever, including for make up because it pills and creates an unflattering appearance. If it were in it a larget tube with product filling the tube, I'd probably have given it a 4 star, but it was mostly air in the tube.
Its a good product to start with azelaic acid 100 percent recommended
I love this product works slowly but works great. Notice brown spots on my face within a couple of weeks! Great for sensitive skin!!

avis.titre: I wish I'd found this sooner
avis.texte: I have combination hormonal acne-prone skin and I'm a licensed esthi. While I was in esthi school my barrier was suffering a bit, I was trying to re-introduce retinoids, and then unexpectedly in school we had to do 2 exfoliating treatments in a row including a chemical peel.... my skin reacted badly with a few cysts. I needed to give my barrier time to heal and then reintroduce a gentler active to help, and I chose to use azelaic acid. I started seeing results in as little as a week! It calmed my inflammation and prevented new breakouts. It's been a few months since that big breakout and now my skin has stayed calm thanks to regular use of azelaic, and I've been able to successfully reintroduce my retinoid too. And I've had no issues with the texture of this product. Love it!

avis.titre: Does fade acne scars and sun spot
avis.texte: I'm about 3/4 through my bottle, I use twice a day before hylauronic acid and I have noticed my acne scars and sun spots fading. They're not completely gone but they are noticeably less darker.

I was hesitant to buy again because they changed the formula but it still works great for me. I pair it with Cerave vitamin C in the mornings and with azleic acid at night and it has my skin looking radiant. Try it!
I plan on keeping this in my skincare routine because it does what it says and very affordable.

I ordered this product because I have very textured and red skin because of my rosacea. I've tried many things to get my skin nice and smoother and less red, and nothing has worked. This helped so much with the redness on my face, and 20 minutes after putting it on, my skin felt so much smoother. I definitely recommend it!
reduces redness, works effectively, am use, lightweight, nice on skin,-wish the tube was bigger!!
I can't do a full review because I'm already out of product. Haven't had his even 3 weeks. I won't be purchasing again

avis.titre: 0 difference after 3 months of consistent use
avis.texte: Used every night as directed for 3+ months and truly no difference at all. So bummed.

avis.titre: Surprisingly pretty effective with my redness
avis.texte: I have severe redness all over my face and Im very paranoid about what I put on my face. I love the velvet after feeling I get with this product. I also use it only at night given the other reviews. The only complaint I have is that it is only sold in this small size.

Hormonal acne has kicked my butt during pregnancy, and almost nothing helped at until this (even other brands/types of azalaic acid). This didn't cure the issue entirely but it is one of the only things that visibly helped and made a noticable difference for me in an issue that was really impacting my confidence! Recommend buying multiple at a time if you like it because it can run out quickly.

I cant speak to how well this product works for hyperpigmentation because it pills so horribly you literally cannot use any other products with it. And forget about wearing foundation over it! As someone who is 37 yo and struggling with hormonal acne, my other products are a non negotiable, so I rarely use this except occasionally on the weekends when I dont wear makeup. And when I do use it, it seems like I get an increase of blackheads a day later. Im glad this wasnt expensive because it mainly sits on my vanity taking up space lol. If you have a similar sitch as me, I highly recommend the acne kit from Tula; it also has azaleic acid in it, and has done wonders for my acne AND fading my acne scars.
I love this product so much. It's so amazing it moisturize my skin, brighten my skin, and even my skin tone definitely a gem

avis.titre: My skin texture and breakouts got worse
avis.texte: This was supposed to be a rosacea friendly acne management product. It smells awful. It pills up badly if you don't give it 3-4 minutes to absorb and I've had more breakouts after 6 weeks of use.

This product has genuinely changed my skin for the better. Ive been using this for about 2 1/2 months and my skin has become so smooth. before I started using this product I had a big problem with old acne scars and bumpy texture but this product has gotten rid of all texture and faded many of my scars. I use this product only at night, and i ONLY use a moisturizer before using this product, ive never experienced any burning or pilling with this product either🤷🏽‍♀️ some cons about this product tho its very small and while a little product goes a long way theres only half the product in the packaging. the smell isnt very strong and I kinda like it, will definitely be repurchasing this product.

I have some hormonal acne under my chin and I had read online about how to treat different types of acne and came across Azelaic Acid. I was previously using Salicylic Acid and it wasnt really helping for the acne I had so I was hesitant for awhile but finally decided to purchase this from a brand I trust, Ordinary Brand, and the results have happened rather instantly. It says AM/PM but I skip AM and mainly do it PM. I really like this product and the results show well
iv made this part of my skin care routine. iv noticed a huge difference with my skin. I highly recommend.
I dont know how well it works because I tried to use it twice in 2 different ways but it PILLED HORRIBLY.
As soon as i started using the product seen the results immediately. Redness has subsided on my face.
This has REALLY helped eith hyperpigmentation from acne on my face. I use it once a day and i do notice a difference after a week of using it daily.
This serum makes my skin feel so supple and soft after my cleansing step in my routine. I can't tell if its getting rid of my hyperpigmentation tho

I have acne dont whats my skin type, but i used this like three times over vacation cuz my friend let me have hers and right after i used this shi my skin felt like a pillow and my skin looked amazing
I use this on my arms ans it takes awsy the tiny bumbs i get in my dry state. A little goes a long way and i follow with lotion

I have bought this product three times now. I have pros and cons about this product. I do feel like it is the cheapest for what it is. But every time I use it, I feel a tight tingling on my face. I also feel like the tube is always a little low on product when I get it. But overall I love the way it makes my face feel/look.

bought this because i read good reviews about it helping with perioral dermatitis. honestly this has helped so much with clearing my dermatits, BUTT has also helped so much with evening texture. i believe it has also helped control oiliness. i wpildnt recommend to someone with dry skin because it can be drying

As a black woman with oily, acne prone skin that has tried a ton of pricey products to fade my dark spots, I appreciate this product. I wouldn't say it's been the best in eliminating my post acne scarring, but it is my absolute go to for minimizing oily skin especially with sunscreen. Yes, it is sticky, but that really comes in handy for all night makeup. After cleansing, exfoliating, and using this? Omg even my drug store foundation applies like butter and wears like second skin. Yes yes yes.

This product isn't for me. But that doesnt mean its not good. I have combo oily skin and this product was much to rich for my skin type, and it also didnt wear well under my makeup, it caused peeling. For someone that doesn't wear face makeup and doesnt share my skin type, I think they would love it and find it fairly beneficial to keep in their arsenal.

avis.titre: Great for post acne and sun damage spots
avis.texte: I tried this after years of tanning WITHOUT SUNSCREEN and WITH any type of oil, INCLUDING crisco...yes I know im an idiot, but I was young and dumb. with that said after a few weeks of consistent use I notice how very effective this stuff truly is. it wears beautifully under makeup, didnt break me out and did what it said. To top it off, ITS AFFORDABLE! Couldn't ask for more from a skincare product!
This gage my skin crazy texture. Maybe it waa too strong for my sensitive skin 😟

I just got it today so I this review isn't really about the quality but the quantity. I thought the tube felt really AIR tight so I put a flashlight up against it and what do you know its not even half way full! Theres barely product in the tube. The tube should be FILLED to the top why am paying for less than half of a product???
It doesn't last long but wow it works great! I have perioral dermatitis and finding things that work was a challenge to say the least.

I just started using this and have immediately noticed a difference in my skin texture and appearance! SO SOFT and poreless (pores weren't even an "issue" for me). For reference, I also have Eczema/Sensitive skin- and all good on sensitivity!

avis.titre: Makes my face feels very dry, and ... painful
avis.texte: My cheeks are always red, and my dermatologist recommended using this for 3 weeks then slowly add my regular facial products to see which one is making my cheeks red. The first 2-3 days of using this cream on my face, my face felt very tight and dry, and it was an uncomfortable feeling. By Day 3, I decided to add facial lotion on top of this cream, after it was dried, with the hope that the tightness and dry feeling would go away. Instantly, as i was applying facial cream on my face, my face started feeling like there were hundreds of pins all over it. It was so uncomfortable and some what painful. Even when I tried to wash it off, the painful sensation continues for awhile. I gave my face break from this cream, and a few days later, I repeat the routine, and again, as soon as I started putting another facial cream on my face, the pain returns. Either way, I don't like how it made my face feel, even when used alone. One thing I do like is this facial cream is very smooth to touch, reminds me of baby powder on skin.

I saw this product in a skin care video so I decided to try it and I have been using this product for about two weeks and my skin has completely changed. My red spots are fading and I have no active acne currently! To use it I just put a large pea-sized amount on clean, dry skin and then follow it with my normal moisturizer after i let it sit for a minute. I have just been using facewash, this, and moisturizer, and i only use this product at night because it does pill up if you touch it too much after application. I find that it works best at night anyways. If your skin is sensitive you can use a serum before you apply this product to add a little barrier but i haven't tried that. DISCLAIMER: my skin did purge for about a week after i started using this (old acne came to the surface) but my red spots started fading right away and the purging ended after that week for me. this product also has a light chemical smell but i don't even notice it after i use my moisturizer. FOR REFERENCE: I had painful hormonal acne all over my cheeks and jawline (some of it was deep and some surface level) for months before i tried this. My skin is sensitive to certain products and oily

I've gone through 2 tubes of this product over the last 2 years. I recently switched to a different azaleic acid product that I like better than this one. This one is effective for fading post acne scars, but slowly. It is also very affordable. However, my main issue is that every time I use it, the taste of the product always manages to find its way to my mouth and its disgusting!! It also burns badly in the creases of my nose. The texture is oddly chalky as well. I recently switched to a liquid serum azaleic acid which is way better.

avis.titre: Good product-- not a good value for the money
avis.texte: Not much product in this tube. I've used it less than a month and it's empty already. Good product-- makes skin feel amazing and works well for skin clarity
When used after a clean face, it makes your face so soft. I recommend.
they had a good product before they changed it ! Bring back the original formula.
no smell, feels very light! i use it after cleansing and before moisturizing am and pm and have noticed a difference in 3 days

I'll start by saying this product seems great- it feels good on the skin and seems to work quickly on acne. However, the tube is nearly completely empty. It came sealed, but there is definitely not 30mL, as stated… manufacturing error? I probably only have enough product to last 5 days. Very disappointing
Does an amazing job reducing my hyperpigmentation. Goes on light and smooth without irritating my skin. It's an essential part of my daily skin care routine.
I will not be purchasing this brand again because when the bottle changed this product started causing breaks-outs. When it was in the clear bottle i never had a problem.
This product is very effective in controlling my redness. It is also gentle on the skin.

Love this product, noticed results almost immediately. I have cystic acne/hormonal acne and this product has helped with blemishes and post acne dark spots. I have tried numerous products for acne and this has been the most helpful so far. I also have sensitive skin and havent noticed any irritation in the 2 weeks ive been using this product. My skin has also felt softer/smoother. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!

When a dermatologist recommends this by name, you know it's a good choice. One of the only products I can use for acne-prone skin while trying to conceive. My skin looks miles better from a couple of years ago. And a great price!
My dermatologist recommended this product. It truly does calm the redness on my face as well as nullifying any pimple prone areas.

avis.titre: Holy Cow Noticed a big difference in even the spot test
avis.texte: Noticed softer skin instantly. First use. Makes skin glow. I look forward to seeing how it works after a couple weeks.
I have quite the pregnancy acne so I've been using this in the AM and the glycolic acid toner at night and I've noticed a lot of improvement!
This product really helps keep my rosacea in check and my acne at bay. If I ever manage to not use it, I always regret it the next day. This is a must have for us folks with easily reddened skin.

I'm in my mid-40s w/ combo normal/oily skin in summertime, combo dry/normal skin in wintertime. This stuff saves my skin during the winter. During the summer I don't really use it, since our summers are super humid and HOT. That said, I can see how it could be too much for younger skin or oily skin, but for me, its really saves my skin seasonally!

This works really well and definitely did brighten up my skin and clear my acne, however i would only recommend this if you want to use it at night. This pills SO BAD if you try to put anything other than moisturizer over it! It has a very silicone-like texture and can be drying if you don't follow up with moisturizer. I find it best to wait about 15 minutes for it to soak in before moisturizing.

I used this product every evening. I figured it would be safe after reading the instructions. After only a couple of uses, my skin was red, irritated, and covered in acne. I thought it was just purging, but it never stopped. I had stop using.

avis.titre: Not what it used to be
avis.texte: This used to be my #1 product in my skin care routine. I used to swear by it. I noticed the bottle changed last time i purchased it but the serum seems to have changed as well. It used to be odorless and now it has a strong fishy smell. I pushed passed the smell and used it anyway but it hasnt had any effect on my skin. It's definitely not the same product. What a shame.

avis.titre: No I wouldn't buy this product again
avis.texte: It smells like garlic and I don't feel refreshed after using or feel like it's doing anything for my pigmentation

I absolutely love this stuff. It works to remove my redness almost immediately and leaves my skin very soft. My only complaint is the bottle is very small for the piece and it doesn't come ever half way full. I was actually super annoyed by how little product was in this already very small bottle.

The product felt pretty oily/sticky on my skin. After about a week I noticed small bumps along my jawline. My makeup would appear blotchy after a few hours, which it didn't do if i wasn't wearing this product. I didn't notice any improvement in the brightness of my skin either.

Have been using it daily and have very sensitive skin with no issues. ( use moisturizer with it and f.a.b. cream if I seemed dry. Rosasia has significantly lessened in redness and ever all color. Love the texture if the crem as well

I have very stubborn acne and this helped calm my breakout so quickly. Within a day or two, I noticed that my breakout was smaller, less inflamed, less painful, and less red. It made me feel so much more comfortable. I haven't used it for long enough to see any brightening effects.

It made my cheeks all bumpy and then they slowly started itching and now my face is totally red and bumpy. Only used it twice over the last three days. I was hoping it would calm my slightly red areas and brighten any dull skin but my skin was mostly very smooth and I just hope the rash goes away quickly.
This product broke me out real bad. Sensitive skin people, please be aware! My face is itchy and burning since a week.

I was hesitant but I do have to say since I started using this. It had helped so much, I have very sensitive skin, cystic acne, combo skin and I tend to break out alot. But since I added this with a new moisturizer, cleanser 🫶 is perfect 👌

avis.titre: The tube feels half empty- but will purchase a larger size
avis.texte: I purchased the small size to make sure my teenager doesn't have a reaction and thankfully he has not, but the tube feels half empty which is the disappointment. I will purchase the large size after the bite size tube is finished which apparently will be very soon.

I have tried sooooo many products for my hyperpigmentation. Nothing worked as well as this product over Vitamin C serum. I usually prefer serums, but this product is NOT greasy at all. I'm genuinely impressed. I wish this came in a larger size. But the price is so reasonable that I can just replinish with fresh product as needed.

I really liked the actually product itself and definitely noticed a difference. The price is great but there is barely any product in the package. The packaging also is not the best and everytime I squeeze it either a lot of product comes out or nothing at all. I used this for like 2 weeks not even every day and I am already out of it?

This product has helped me so much with my acne the only thing is it's packaging is absolutely horrendous. It is so hard to get product out or too much comes out. I wish they would package it differently and make a bigger size.

I gave this a try about a year ago when my skin barrier was damaged and had lots of acne. I gave up thinking it was making things worse. Now that I've worked with a dermatologist to gety acne under control, I have noticed a reduction in the red spots I had post-acne. I use it every morning and have no irritation. It is great for the price!
Works miracles on my hyperpigmentation spots. I use it once daily and it's faded my spots without irritation or causing breakouts. I've been using this for years now and absolutely love it.

ive had 3 bottles of this. the last 2 came in clear bottles and were odorless. my last one came in a dark bottle and has a weird garlicy smell. it used to be good but now it just makes me feel gross after using it cus of the smell
Its an affordable acid. I definitely enjoyed it as my first azaelic acid. I used this in combination with the la roche b5 serum and saw the slow progress working.

I'm 31 and have struggled with acne, scarring, and texture since I was in my teens. I'm currently 20 weeks pregnant and have been battling crazy hormonal acne and whitehead clusters but didn't know what was safe to use while pregnant - this popped up while doing some TikTok research. After just 4 days of using this only at night, my skin is visibly smoother and more even toned and my pregnancy acne has (so far) disappeared! I don't love the thick primer-like consistency, but if it keeps working this well for me I will keep purchasing!!!

I've struggled wirh BRIGHT red cheeks during and after pregnancy. Nothing seemed to work and only made it worse. Found this magic in a bottle and finally seeing my redness fade! Been using nightly for two months and definitely seeing results.

I just bought this 3 DAYS AGO, & i can see a difference on my CHIN CHEEKS AND SKIN TEXTURE. I paired it with the Aloe 2% NAG solution and just wow. ONLY 3 DAYS. My skin is alot brighter my breakouts are nearly almost all gone. Ive tried everything and i guess AZELAIC ACID IS THAT GIRL!

avis.titre: Silky texture! So far so good...
avis.texte: I started using this a couple of weeks ago for redness in my cheeks that I suspect may be rosacea. In any case, the redness seems to have calmed down slightly, but I understand that azelaic acid needs a minimum of 6 weeks to show clear improvement, so I'm going to continue to use it and see what happens. The texture is thick and silky, no grittiness, despite the fact that it's a suspension. I haven't noticed any stinging, either. I put it on last in my routine, on bare skin OR after a serum or light moisturizer. I try to use it 2x a day, but some days I only manage to do it 1x.

avis.titre: Formula Change on my Holy Grail
avis.texte: This has been my holy grail, everyday product with incredible results but after having an alarming experience on the first day of vacation, the company confirmed they changed the formulation. It also now has a strong fish odor on the skin.

My dermatologist recommended this product for the horomonal acne I was getting during my pregnancy. I had painful, deep, cystic acne all along my cheeks and jaw line. After using this product morning + night for just over a month now, my acne is almost completely gone! I even feel like it helped even out my skin tone. On my second bottle already. Would HIGHLY recommend for anyone dealing with acne! Definitely use consistently if you want to see results… like i said, i had to use it for about 5 weeks before my face started to clear completely.

Ive had rosacea for 15 years. Ive never had any product actually work in reducing it until this one! After about a month of using it, my redness is almost completely gone. My large pores on my cheeks look much better as well.

Effective and gentle on my sensitive skin. My fair, freckled complexion is noticeably brighter, spots and freckles are significantly faded. I use daily in combination with the Ordinary Cold Pressed Rose Hip Oil, Moisturizer and Glycolic Acid toner.

avis.titre: tiny red bumps and rash, itchy
avis.texte: Was looking forward to addressing acne scars and hyperpigmentation. I was only able to use the product twice before my skin completely rejected it. I did see a brightening and tightening effect, but that didn't matter because it caused tiny red bumps to appear and an itchy, painful rash. I had to wash it off and hoping the rash doesn't scar. Clearly, I'm allergic to one of the ingredients. Still open to cautiously trying products from this brand.
I have rosacea and hear good things about azelaic acid for redness. I couldn't tell with the redness since my face is tan but my face felt so soft and smooth

Purchased this twice, with the first one I felt like it finished pretty fast, when I opened the second one I noticed right away that the bottle was almost empty.. like a bag of chips. Will purchase my azelaic acid from a different brand henceforth.

I absolutely loved the ordinary's azelaic acid formula! As an acne-prone brown girl (who is also prone to hyperpigmentation left by post-acne scars), I see a vast difference in my skin texture, pores, brightness and fading hyperpigmentation on weeks I use this cream. I've even tried the Paula's choice azelaic acid (which is maybe more than 3-4x times the price of this one) but have noticed wayyy better results with TO's formula. I have been repurchasing this since 2021 and the formula has honestly been pretty consistent (maybe even better?). Tried every acne treatment under the sun and this definitely is at the top. You don't need too much product either to see results (I personally notice it in a day or two) - just use it consistently for 2 weeks. Use it before moisturizer AM & PM. Follow it up with sunscreen in the AM.

I used this product one time. It immediately turned my skin red and started burning. I woke up with an extremely dry face. Returning it.
I bought this to help with dark spots and dull skin but this dried out my skin so badly. Definitely only use if you have oily skin.

I liked this product since it was so cheap and did help subside any breakouts, however, I didn't see much change. I used this product consisitently and went through it fairly quickly compared to other The Ordinary serums. If you have a few pimples this could be a good option, but if you have a good amount of acnr scars I feel like there is better options out there.

I have dry skin, acne & rosacea. I've added this to my daily skin care to help with the redness. I use a prescription topical cream that wasn't cutting it alone for my rosacea, but with this added to everything - my skin finally is glowing!

I bought this thinking i would give it a try, but it just did not work for me. I put it on two nights in a row and my face is dried out. I have dark spots around my eyes and my lips because of dry skin and this product made it worse. I used this in combination with a serum also from ordinary and i do not wear makeup. This product made my skin feel very sensitive.

I have been using this product faithfully for 2 and a half years, always applying it as the last step in my routine directly after applying moisturizer. The change is it has made is incredible. I have always been self-conscious about my overly red face, but since I incorporated this product into my routine I RARELY have to worry about redness.
My dermatologist suggested for my rosacea and it did not disappoint cheap and it works. I always love this brand.
My dermatologist suggested for my rosacea and it did not disappoint cheap and it works. I always love this brand.
I purchased this to address hyper pigmentation. I use this product faithfully, twice a day, for a couple months. This product made Difference no difference. Also, this smells like garlic.
Have been using for years. Works as good as 15% prescription for me.

This is a great product for me, I'm a Fitzpatrick 3 and it really evens out your skin tone. It's suppose to have some of the chemical properties of a hydroquinone but in a safer gentler approach. I've only used it a week and can tell a difference but my skin responds very fast and others may need more time.

This is my go to product to help with rosacea. I get flare ups and bumpy rosacea that looks like acne but isn't and I use this at night after cleansing only on days that my skin needs help and I finally feel like this condition is more under control!
